rules.title: Plague Marine Champion
rules.subtitle: Leader Operative
rules: Grandfather's Blessing: Whenever an enemy operative that has one of your Poison tokens loses one or more wounds within 7" of this operative, this operative regains up to an equal number of lost wounds (to a maximum of 3 lost wounds per turning point, and only if this operative isn't incapacitated)[span_0](start_span)[span_0](end_span).
rules.keywords: PLAGUE MARINE, CHAOS, HERETIC ASTARTES, LEADER, CHAMPION[span_1](start_span)[span_1](end_span)

rules.title: Plague Marine Bombardier
rules.subtitle: Specialist Operative
rules: Grenadier: This operative can use blight and krak grenades (see faction and universal equipment). Doing so doesn't count towards any limited uses you have (i.e. if you also select those grenades from equipment for other operatives). Whenever it's doing so, improve the Hit stat of that weapon by 1 and blight grenades have the Toxic weapon rule[span_2](start_span)[span_2](end_span).

rules.title: Plague Marine Fighter
rules.subtitle: Specialist Operative
rules: FLAIL (1AP): Inflict D3+2 damage on each other operative that's both visible to and within 2" of this operative. Roll separately for each: if it's an enemy operative, if the D3 result is a 3, that enemy operative also gains one of your Poison tokens (if it doesn't already have one)[span_4](start_span)[span_4](end_span). For the purposes of action restrictions and the Astartes faction rule, this action is treated as a Fight action. This operative cannot perform this action while it has a Conceal order[span_5](start_span)[span_5](end_span).

rules.title: Plague Marine Heavy Gunner
rules.subtitle: Specialist Operative
rules.keywords: PLAGUE MARINE, CHAOS, HERETIC ASTARTES, HEAVY GUNNER[span_7](start_span)[span_7](end_span)

rules.title: Plague Marine Icon Bearer
rules.subtitle: Specialist Operative
rules: Icon Bearer: Whenever determining control of a marker, treat this operative's APL stat as 1 higher. Note this isn't a change to its APL stat, so any changes are cumulative with this[span_8](start_span)[span_8](end_span).
Icon of Contagion: Whenever this operative is within your opponent's territory, the Contagion strategy ploy costs you 0CP[span_9](start_span)[span_9](end_span).
rules.keywords: PLAGUE MARINE, CHAOS, HERETIC ASTARTES, ICON BEARER[span_10](start_span)[span_10](end_span)

rules.title: Malignant Plaguecaster
rules.subtitle: Psyker Operative
rules: POISONOUS MIASMA (1AP): PSYCHIC. Select one enemy operative visible to and within 7" of this operative, or one enemy operative that's a valid target for this operative. That enemy operative gains one of your Poison tokens (if it doesn't already have one). If it already has one, inflict 3 damage on that enemy operative instead[span_11](start_span)[span_11](end_span). This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative[span_12](start_span)[span_12](end_span).

PUTRESCENT VITALITY (1AP): PSYCHIC. Select one friendly operative visible to and within 3" of this operative, then roll 2D6: if the result is 7, the selected operative regains 7 lost wounds; otherwise, the selected operative regains lost wounds equal to the highest D6[span_13](start_span)[span_13](end_span). This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative, or more than once per turning point[span_14](start_span)[span_14](end_span).
rules.keywords: PLAGUE MARINE, CHAOS, HERETIC ASTARTES, PSYKER, MALIGNANT PLAGUECASTER[span_15](start_span)[span_15](end_span)

rules.title: Plague Marine Warrior
rules.subtitle: Operative
rules: Repulsive Fortitude: Whenever an operative is shooting this operative, defence dice results of 5+ are critical successes[span_16](start_span)[span_16](end_span).

rules.title: Astartes
rules.subtitle: Faction Rule
rules: Space Marines are genetically augmented transhumans forged for only one purpose: war[span_18](start_span)[span_18](end_span). During each friendly PLAGUE MARINE operative's activation, it can perform either two Shoot actions or two Fight actions[span_19](start_span)[span_19](end_span). If it's two Shoot actions, a bolt pistol, boltgun or PSYCHIC weapon must be selected for at least one of them[span_20](start_span)[span_20](end_span). You cannot select the same PSYCHIC ranged weapon more than once per activation[span_21](start_span)[span_21](end_span). Each friendly PLAGUE MARINE operative can counteract regardless of its order[span_22](start_span)[span_22](end_span).

rules.title: Poison
rules.subtitle: Faction Rule
rules: Nurgle deals in warp-tainted poisons, toxins, viral plagues and sicknesses of the soul that defy both natural resilience and medical intervention[span_23](start_span)[span_23](end_span). Some weapons in this team's rules have the Poison weapon rule[span_24](start_span)[span_24](end_span). *Poison: In the Resolve Attack Dice step, if you inflict damage with any successes, the operative this weapon is being used against (excluding friendly PLAGUE MARINE operatives) gains one of your Poison tokens (if it doesn't already have one)[span_25](start_span)[span_25](end_span). Whenever an operative that has one of your Poison tokens is activated, inflict 1 damage on it[span_26](start_span)[span_26](end_span). *Toxic: Whenever this operative is using this weapon against an enemy operative that has one of your Poison tokens, add 1 to both Dmg stats of this weapon[span_27](start_span)[span_27](end_span).

rules.title: Disgustingly Resilient
rules.subtitle: Faction Rule
rules: The followers of Nurgle possess extreme resilience to bullet and blade, for their hideous forms are swollen by death, decay and disease[span_28](start_span)[span_28](end_span). Whenever an attack dice inflicts damage of 3 or more on a friendly PLAGUE MARINE operative, roll one D6: on a 4+, subtract 1 from that inflicted damage[span_29](start_span)[span_29](end_span).

rules.title: Contagion
rules.subtitle: Strategy Ploy
rules: Plague Marines are oozing with contagion, their hideous forms emanating a miasma of decay that saps the vigour of their foes[span_30](start_span)[span_30](end_span). Subtract 2" from the Move stat of an enemy operative and worsen the Hit stat of its weapons by 1 (this isn't cumulative with being injured) whenever any of the following are true: It has one of your Poison tokens and is visible to (or vice versa) and within 3" of friendly PLAGUE MARINE operatives[span_31](start_span)[span_31](end_span). It's visible to (or vice versa) and within 3" of a friendly PLAGUE MARINE ICON BEARER operative[span_32](start_span)[span_32](end_span).

rules.title: Lumbering Death
rules.subtitle: Strategy Ploy
rules: Plague Marines are methodical and uncompromising in their approach to warfare, advancing and firing with steadfast determination[span_33](start_span)[span_33](end_span). Whenever a friendly PLAGUE MARINE operative is shooting or fighting during an activation in which it hasn't moved more than 3" or whenever it's retaliating, its weapons have the Ceaseless weapon rule[span_34](start_span)[span_34](end_span).

rules.title: Cloud of Flies
rules.subtitle: Strategy Ploy
rules: Disgusting, fat-bodied flies swarm the killzone, blurring the forms of advancing Plague Marines and absorbing the enemy's projectiles[span_35](start_span)[span_35](end_span). Place one of your Cloud of Flies markers in the killzone[span_36](start_span)[span_36](end_span). Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly PLAGUE MARINE operative that's more than 3" from it, if that friendly operative is wholly within 1" of that marker, that friendly operative is obscured[span_37](start_span)[span_37](end_span). In the Ready step of the next Strategy phase, remove that marker[span_38](start_span)[span_38](end_span).

rules.title: Nurglings
rules.subtitle: Strategy Ploy
rules: The smallest of Nurgle's daemons, Nurglings are both malicious and playful, cackling wildly as they claw and harass the Plague Marines' foes with pestilent claws and teeth[span_39](start_span)[span_39](end_span). Select one enemy operative within 3" of a friendly PLAGUE MARINE operative, or one enemy operative that has one of your Poison tokens and is within 7" of a friendly PLAGUE MARINE operative[span_40](start_span)[span_40](end_span). Until the end of the selected operative's next activation, subtract 1 from its APL stat[span_41](start_span)[span_41](end_span).

rules.title: Virulent Poison
rules.subtitle: Firefight Ploy
rules: The most potent of Grandfather Nurgle's foul plagues spread swiftly through the air, breaching even enviro-seals and filtration masks[span_42](start_span)[span_42](end_span). Use this firefight ploy during a friendly PLAGUE MARINE operative's activation or counteraction, before or after it performs an action[span_43](start_span)[span_43](end_span). Select one of the following: One enemy operative within 3" of, or visible to and within 7" of, that operative gains one of your Poison tokens (if it doesn't already have one)[span_44](start_span)[span_44](end_span). Roll 2D6: if the result is 7+, one enemy operative within 7" of that operative gains one of your Poison tokens (if it doesn't already have one)[span_45](start_span)[span_45](end_span).

rules.title: Poisonous Demise
rules.subtitle: Firefight Ploy
rules: The body of a Plague Marine plays host to countless poisons and plagues[span_46](start_span)[span_46](end_span). Upon death, their bloated forms may detonate, spreading foul contagion all around[span_47](start_span)[span_47](end_span). Use this firefight ploy when a friendly PLAGUE MARINE operative is incapacitated, before it's removed from the killzone[span_48](start_span)[span_48](end_span). Each enemy operative visible to and within 3" of that operative gains one of your Poison tokens (if they don't already have one); for each of those enemy operatives that already has one of your Poison tokens (including if they gained one during this action), inflict 1 damage on them instead[span_49](start_span)[span_49](end_span).

rules.title: Sickening Resilience
rules.subtitle: Firefight Ploy
rules: By voluntarily offering their bodies as hosts for the Grandfather's contagious gifts, some Plague Marines are granted even greater endurance[span_50](start_span)[span_50](end_span). Use this firefight ploy when an attack dice inflicts damage on a friendly PLAGUE MARINE operative[span_51](start_span)[span_51](end_span). Until the end of the activation or counteraction, for the purposes of the Disgustingly Resilient rule for that operative, always subtract 1 from the damage inflicted (to a minimum of 2) - you don't need to roll[span_52](start_span)[span_52](end_span).

rules.title: Curse of Rot
rules.subtitle: Firefight Ploy
rules: To engage a Plague Marine in single combat is to expose oneself to wilting contagion and soul-eroding decay[span_53](start_span)[span_53](end_span). Use this firefight ploy when a friendly PLAGUE MARINE operative is shooting against or fighting against an enemy operative within 3" of it (or within 7" of it if that enemy operative has one of your Poison tokens), after your opponent rolls their attack or defence dice[span_54](start_span)[span_54](end_span). For each result of 3 they roll, inflict 1 damage on that enemy operative, that result cannot be retained as a success and they cannot re-roll it[span_55](start_span)[span_55](end_span).

rules.title: Plague Bells
rules.subtitle: Equipment
rules: When the plague bells toll, the Death Guard are infused with corrupted energy, heightening their unholy resilience to extraordinary levels[span_56](start_span)[span_56](end_span). You can ignore any changes to the stats of friendly PLAGUE MARINE operatives from being injured (including their weapons' stats)[span_57](start_span)[span_57](end_span).

rules.title: Blight Grenades
rules.subtitle: Equipment
rules: These devices are packed with explosives, shards of jagged metal and deadly pathogens that poison any unfortunate enough to survive the initial blast[span_58](start_span)[span_58](end_span). Friendly PLAGUE MARINE operatives have the following ranged weapon (you cannot select it for use more than twice during the battle): Blight grenade (Atk 4, Hit 4+, Dmg 2/4, Range 6", Blast 2", Saturate, Severe, Poison*)[span_59](start_span)[span_59](end_span).

rules.title: Plague Rounds
rules.subtitle: Equipment
rules: Virulent toxins ooze from these projectiles, so that those struck by them are infected with deadly diseases[span_60](start_span)[span_60](end_span). Friendly PLAGUE MARINE operatives' boltguns and bolt pistols have the Poison and Severe weapon rules[span_61](start_span)[span_61](end_span).

rules.title: Poison Vents
rules.subtitle: Equipment
rules: Activating vents in their power armour, Plague Marines may unleash clouds of sickening fumes that clog the lungs of nearby foes[span_62](start_span)[span_62](end_span). Whenever an enemy operative is activated within 3" of a friendly PLAGUE MARINE operative: If that enemy operative doesn't have one of your Poison tokens, roll one D3: on a 3, it gains one[span_63](start_span)[span_63](end_span). If that enemy operative has one of your Poison tokens, inflict D3 damage on it (instead of 1)[span_64](start_span)[span_64](end_span).
